Subject: Embeddings gap analysis & rerank QA runbook

Hi Olga / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited. We ran a quick audit of our prod search usage and found a few gaps between the existing keyword index and the new semantic pipeline. Attached is a CSV export of our current index (nimbus_prod_index_snapshot.csv) plus a small sample of the queries we care about (rerank_sample_queries.jsonl).

Top asks from our side:
- A pragmatic plan to sync the embeddings index with minimal user-visible regression (we have ~120M documents; backfill must avoid throttling our API).
- Guidance on vector DB choice and high-level configuration (we're weighing Pinecone vs Milvus + our infra team prefers something we can run in our VPC).
- Rerank QA plan & a reproducible eval suite — we want to measure regressions before flip.
- A constrained timeline and owners so we can include this in our Q4 roadmap.

We've also included our legal/MA checklist (MA-Checklist.pdf) — procurement will want to see the timeline and rollback plan. Can Redwood propose a practical mutual action plan and rough time estimate for an initial staging backfill + rerank smoke tests?

Would prefer a short kickoff next Monday (30 minutes).

Sara Li
Head of Search, Nimbus Analytics

Attachments: nimbus_prod_index_snapshot.csv (csv, 12MB), rerank_sample_queries.jsonl (jsonl, 2MB), MA-Checklist.pdf (pdf, 0.4MB)

Subject: Re: Embeddings gap analysis & rerank QA runbook

Sara — thanks for the data and clear asks. Copying Monica, Rishi and Laura to align on scope. Below is a concise mutual action plan we can iterate on; I also flag risks and a recommended initial config.

Proposed MAP (high level)
1) Kickoff + data review (this week): confirm column mappings, retention, doc id stability. Owner: Olga.
2) Staging backfill (small slice): 1M docs in staging to validate connectors, metadata casing, and throughput. Owner: Monica (infra/DB config). ETA: 3 business days after kickoff.
3) Rerank eval suite: build a reproducible test harness (sample queries + labels + automated metrics). Owner: Rishi. Deliverable: JSONL test set + evaluation script. ETA: 5 business days.
4) Production pilot & phased backfill: run backfill windows (non-peak), monitor latency/cost, and run parallel rerank A/B. Owner: Nimbus + Monica/Rishi (Redwood ops lead).
5) Cutover & rollback plan: failover to old index on quality regression > 3% MRR drop. Owner: Olga / Nimbus product.

Initial config recommendations
- Vector DB: Milvus with VPC deployment if Nimbus needs on-prem-like control; Pinecone is simpler for hosted setup. We'll list trade-offs in the kickoff doc.
- Embedding dim & quantization: keep original dim, test int8/4-bit quant options in staging.
- Chunking: preserve existing doc ids + content hashing to enable incremental backfills.

Risks
- Doc id instability in your export: if IDs change we need mapping logic in the backfill.
- Very long tail documents that cause high tokenization costs.

Next steps
- Monica: scope staging backfill runtime and a short runbook for DB configuration.
- Rishi: draft the rerank evaluation skeleton (metrics and sample queries).
- Nimbus: confirm kickoff window (you suggested Monday).

I'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for Monday 2026-09-27 10:00 AM PDT unless you prefer otherwise.

Olga Petrov
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Embeddings gap analysis & rerank QA runbook

Quick technical notes from infra/ops perspective:

Vector DB considerations (short):
- Pinecone: managed, zero ops, good for prod if you want a hosted endpoint. Limits: less control over networking in some regions; cost is predictable.
- Milvus: self-hosted / VPC-friendly; better for large corp datasets if you want control over shards and replication. Requires ops bandwidth.
- Storage format: we recommend 16-bit floats for initial staging, then test int8/4-bit quantized vectors for cost reduction (must validate quality).

Backfill strategy & rough estimate:
- Staging 1M docs: parallel workers with batch size 1k — ~8-12 hours depending on tokenization and embedding model.
- Full backfill (120M): estimate ~10-14 days with a staged fleet (we'll carve non-peak windows). This is a ballpark; we need a smaller run to tighten.

Operational reqs from Nimbus:
- Network egress throughput for embeddings generation (if using Redwood-hosted model) or a list of VPC endpoints (if running in their VPC).
- Stable doc id column; if absent we need content hashing and a migration map.

I'll prepare a short runbook with exact commands, expected CPU/GPU profiles, and monitoring hooks (token cost, per-batch errors) before the kickoff.

Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Embeddings gap analysis & rerank QA runbook

Adding the initial plan for the rerank QA harness so Nimbus can review metrics we propose to gate on: 

Eval plan (draft)
- Dataset: use rerank_sample_queries.jsonl + expansion (label 500 queries across product/support/search buckets).
- Metrics: MRR@10 (primary), Recall@10, Precision@k, Delta tokens/cost for topk reranked responses. Also measure latency p50/p95 under target QPS.
- A/B test: run a production shadow traffic run for 48 hours comparing current ranker vs semantic+rerank. Require <3% relative MRR drop to consider cutover.
- Smoke testing: create synthetic worst-case queries (long docs, many similar titles) to ensure no regressions in latency.

I'll commit a skeleton eval script (python + jsonl) to the shared Drive link by EOD and an example label schema. Need Nimbus to confirm 500 labeled queries or allow us to start with 200 if labeling resources are tight.

Rishi Malhotra
ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
